Corollary
[Prescribed Mean Curvature Bound] 1. ch10:10.6\group chapter-10 Source: gilbarg-trudinger:page-0279 ↗ gilbarg-trudinger.thm.10.5.integral-bound Let $u\in C^0(\overline\Omega )\cap C^2(\Omega )$ solve (10.7) in a bounded domain. If \begin{equation} H_0:=\int _\Omega |H(x)|^n\, dx<\omega _n, \tag {10.18} \end{equation} then \begin{equation} \sup _\Omega |u|\le \sup _{\partial \Omega }|u| +C(n,H_0)\operatorname {diam}\Omega . \tag {10.19} \end{equation}
Proof

\sketch For (10.7), $\mathscr D=(1+|p|^2)^{n-1}$. Use $g(p)=(1+|p|^2)^{-(n+2)/(2n)}$, for which $\int _{\R ^n}g^n=\omega _n$, in Theorem 14.

□

Theorems 10.3--10.5 and Corollary 10.6 remain valid for $u\in C^0(\overline\Omega )\cap W^{2,n}_{\mathrm{loc}}(\Omega )$.
